WITH refreshed AS (
            UPDATE published_paths
            SET last_pushed_at = NOW()
            WHERE cache_id = $1
                AND store_path_hash = ANY($2)
                AND last_pushed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
            RETURNING id
        )
        SELECT store_path_hash
        FROM published_paths
        WHERE cache_id = $1
            AND store_path_hash = ANY($2)
